sentences.en: Laser rays are used in the restoration of ancient works.
sentences.zh: 激光被用于修复古代作品。

sentences.en: During the restoration work, visitors have limited access to the museum.
sentences.zh: 在修缮工作期间，游客只能有限地进入博物馆。

sentences.en: The restoration of this historic building went on for five years.
sentences.zh: 这座历史建筑的修复工程持续了五年。
